_comment: Flat task list. Each task has a stable id (T-NNNN), a phase_id link, a band_id (which release band closes this task), and status. Tasks tagged 'done' carry git_tag + pr + shipped_at when known. Tasks tagged 'pending'/'in_progress' carry notes describing what's needed. UI lets founder move tasks between phases, re-enable completed ones for enhancement, edit titles/notes, etc.
